data.name: MissingPrimary
data.value: The user settings primary store is absent. Load defaults or explicitly import settings before upgrading.

data.name: MissingBackup
data.value: No user settings backup is available for recovery.

data.name: NewerSchema
data.value: The user settings schema is newer than this application supports. The document was not replaced.

data.name: UpgradeRequired
data.value: The user settings schema requires an explicit UpgradeAsync operation before loading or saving.

data.name: ValidPrimary
data.value: The primary user settings document is valid. Recovery cannot replace it with an older backup.

data.name: MissingMigration
data.value: No user settings migration is registered from schema version {0} to the next version.

data.name: RecoveryRequired
data.value: The primary user settings store is absent but a backup exists. Use RecoverAsync rather than silently replacing it with defaults.

data.name: InvalidModel
data.value: User settings must contain a non-null JSON object compatible with the registered model.

data.name: InvalidDocument
data.value: The user settings document must contain exactly a positive schemaVersion, a positive revision, and an object settings payload.

data.name: InvalidFile
data.value: The user settings file '{0}' contains invalid JSON.

data.name: LockTimeout
data.value: Timed out waiting for exclusive access to user settings at '{0}'.

data.name: InvalidIdentity
data.value: The application ID must be a single, non-reserved Windows directory name without trailing dots or spaces.

data.name: InvalidTimeout
data.value: The contention timeout must be positive and supported by a cancellation timer.

data.name: AbsoluteDirectory
data.value: The user settings storage directory must be an absolute path.

data.name: InvalidMigration
data.value: Migrations must be non-null and keyed by a positive schema version below the current version.
